versions.changelog:
- Added TEST-REPORT-FINAL.md for reporting or test summary.
- Updated documentation to highlight dynamic key (dkey) support, including improved security practices and usage.
- Clarified that API list and configuration are now auto-synced and cached; enhanced instructions for first-time setup.
- Expanded API usage examples for more endpoints, including POST/GET notes and recommended routes.
- Provided more detailed and explicit cron configuration instructions; clarified that users must set up scheduled tasks manually.
- Added and updated interface route, security, and environment variable explanations to clarify multi-line (domain/IP/VIP) failover and dynamic key best practices.

No code or documentation changes detected in this release.

- Version updated to 1.0.3.
- No file or documentation changes from previous version.

- Added initial CHANGELOG.md file for the project.
- SKILL.md updated to v1.0.1: fixed hardcoded paths and server configuration issues according to community feedback.
- Added advanced configuration section, including environment variable and API endpoint override instructions.
- Clarified API list node and automatic fallback/cdn details to improve server reliability.
- Minor enhancements to file structure and usage documentation.

- 更新认证信息页面示例链接中的 shareid，从「你的 ID」改为具体数值「10013679」
- 其余内容保持不变，无功能调整或文档结构修改

apihz-skill v1.0.0

- 首次发布，支持 409+ 企业级稳定 API（天气、地震、IP归属地、邮箱、翻译等）
- 提供开发者认证流程与初始化脚本
- 支持交互式和代码方式调用全部 API 分类
- 包含每日自动签到及抽奖功能
- 详细的调用说明、付费档位、文件结构和使用须知
